articles.summary: Zacks: MTB Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher NII & Fee Income, Stock Down. M&T Bank's Q4 results benefit from higher NII and fee income, though rising costs and an early share decline weigh on sentiment. Related tickers mentioned: MTB, MTB-PJ, MTB-PK.
